card.name: Linking words before a comparison or exposure
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as since, between, after, with, to, or and following, placed right before the thing being compared, given, or exposed to. Seen mostly in study descriptions, plus some web text.

modes.label: Trial arm linkers
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction that introduces the drug or comparator group in a trial sentence.

modes.label: After or since an event
modes.description: A time or comparison word before an event, such as a vaccine, a withdrawal, or a year.
modes.example: A few people have reported health problems after<< getting>> the shot.

modes.label: Inside a title abbreviation
modes.description: The start of the degree M.D. after a name.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that come just before a drug, comparison group, or event in a sentence.
